data: What is the approximate value of recall when the precision of the black line is 0.4?

Wait a moment, let me verify this. The black line represents the MIMLRE model. When the precision is approximately 0.4, I need to look at the corresponding recall value on the y-axis. The black line intersects the precision of 0.4 around the recall value of 0.3. Therefore, the approximate value of recall when the precision of the black line is 0.4 is 0.3.
